prompt: How do I tune a Mridangam?
response: Tuning a Mridangam involves adjusting the tension of the leather straps that hold the membranes in place. Tightening the straps will raise the pitch, while loosening them will lower it. Use a tuning key to make precise adjustments until you achieve the desired sound. It's important to tune the Mridangam before each performance to ensure optimal sound quality.
